name: Height of Binary Tree
description: Computes the height (maximum depth) of a binary tree recursively. Height is the number of edges on the longest path from root to a leaf.
aim: Find the maximum depth from root to any leaf node using post-order DFS: height = 1 + max(height(left), height(right)).
howItWorks: Base case: null node has height -1 (or 0 for node count)
Recursively compute height of left subtree
Recursively compute height of right subtree
Height of current node = 1 + max(leftHeight, rightHeight)

complexity.spaceDescription: Recursion stack depth = tree height h; O(log n) balanced, O(n) skewed

alternatives: Iterative BFS — finds height level by level with O(n) space
